articles.title: Wall Street Giants, Sovereign Wealth Fund Back Canton Network Creator in $355M Round
articles.snippet: Canton Network creator Digital Asset secured $355 million in a funding round led by Andreessen Horowitz alongside an array of other backers.

articles.title: Solana Exchange Raydium Hit With $1.34 Million Exploit as DeFi Attacks Grow
articles.snippet: Solana-based decentralized exchange Raydium will repay the funds swiped in the $1.34 million exploit using its treasury.
